limitations_and_boundaries: The study used a limited number of triple-negative breast cancer samples for the correlation between collagen density and CD8+ T cell abundance.
The study did not address whether collagen density affects T cell migration in addition to activity.
The study focused on direct effects of collagen on T cells; indirect effects via other cell types (e.g., macrophages) were not investigated.

missed_core_items.description: The study used a limited number of triple-negative breast cancer samples (n=20) for the correlation between collagen density and CD8+ T cell abundance, and the negative correlation did not reach statistical significance.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Consistent with our 3D culture data, samples that contained a high collagen density often had fewer infiltrating CD8+ T cells, although this negative correlation failed to reach statistically significance with this limited material (Fig. 2e).

claims.statement: High collagen density reduces T cell proliferation.

experiments_or_tasks: T cells from healthy donors were transiently stimulated with PMA and ionomycin, labelled with CellTrace Violet, and cultured for 5 days in 3D collagen gels of low density (1 mg/ml) or high density (4 mg/ml) collagen type I. Proliferation was measured by flow cytometry using CellTrace Violet dilution and BrdU incorporation.

methods.name: 3D collagen gel culture
methods.protocol_description: Type I collagen gels were prepared with rat tail collagen type I. Low density (LD) gels contained 1 mg/ml collagen, high density (HD) gels contained 4 mg/ml collagen. Cells were resuspended in collagen solution and seeded on top of a pre-polymerized collagen layer. After polymerization, culture media was added.

methods.name: T cell proliferation assay
methods.protocol_description: T cells were stimulated with 10 nM PMA and 175 nM ionomycin, labelled with CellTrace Violet, and cultured for 5 days. Cells were extracted from gels using collagenase, stained with anti-CD3, anti-CD4, anti-CD8 antibodies and Live/Dead stain, and analyzed by flow cytometry. BrdU incorporation was also measured after 3 days of culture.
